message: Most utilities have modernised CIS, AMI, OMS and GIS. The fastest way to get value from them is to apply AI to the whole data-and-AI lifecycle, not only the end use case. Engineer with AI so data products, the network model and agents arrive in weeks, not quarters. Operate with AI so grid, plant, gas, data and agent operations run and heal under control, with operators in command of every device. Decide and act with AI so customers, crews, planners and executives get trusted answers first and then act on them. One control plane governs, secures and assures it all.

rules.why: A governance or OT-security hard blocker comes first: the control plane is put in place before agents act.
GIS connectivity accuracy is low or unknown, so agents would act on the wrong customers and devices. Engineer the network model and core products first.
Products exist but control-room and field processes are manual. Operate with AI next.
Certified products and a semantic layer are in place. Start with Decide and Act.

first90.govern: Control plane in 6 weeks: policy engine, OT cap, CEII handling, evidence trail; then an Engineer pilot
first90.engineer: Assess (4–6 weeks) → Data Product Factory pilot on Outage & Reliability 360 and the Network Connectivity Model
first90.operate: Pilot DataOps healing plus the Fault Location Advisor at L2 with one control room
first90.decide-act: Marketplace + Ask the Utility + the Outage Communication & ETR Agent
